name: Maternal Uniparental Disomy of Chromosome 20 Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Maternal Uniparental Disomy of Chromosome 20 Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Detection of maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 20 by molecular genetic testing
Prenatal and postnatal growth retardation without other identifiable causes
Mild to moderate developmental delay in early childhood
Characteristic facial features including micrognathia and prominent forehead

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of genetic confirmation plus at least two major clinical features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies primarily on molecular genetic testing; clinical features support diagnosis.

imaging: Brain MRI may show nonspecific delayed myelination
genetic: Molecular confirmation of maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 20 by SNP array or microsatellite analysis
other: Prenatal ultrasound showing intrauterine growth restriction
Feeding assessments indicating dysphagia or poor suck reflex

distinguishingFeatures: Silver-Russell syndrome involves imprinting defects on chromosome 11p15 or maternal UPD7
Distinct facial features including triangular face and limb asymmetry
More frequent limb asymmetry than UPD20mat
PWS caused by paternal deletion or maternal UPD15
Severe hypotonia and hyperphagia leading to obesity
Characteristic behavioral phenotype distinct from UPD20mat

redFlags: Severe intrauterine growth retardation with no identifiable cause
Neonatal feeding difficulties requiring tube feeding
Developmental delay with characteristic facial dysmorphism
references: Eggermann T, et al. Maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 20: clinical and molecular characterization. Eur J Hum Genet. 2014.
Orphanet: Maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 20 syndrome. ORPHA:96186.
Wakeling EL, et al. Clinical features of maternal uniparental disomy 20: a rare imprinting disorder. Am J Med Genet A. 2017.
